name: No new machines in a traffic surge (boot dependency)
description: The API servers autoscale: when busy they add machines, and each new machine fetches its config from the provisioning service at boot (the edge is set to "Only at boot"). The scenario triples the traffic at 20 s, and at the same time the provisioning service is swamped (90% errors), like Slack's first working day after the holidays in January 2021: traffic surged, and the network and services that new machines need to boot were the ones swamped. New machines keep failing to boot (see the API's "Boot failures" and the timeline), so the original 4 carry three times the traffic. Try this: delete the API → provisioning service edge (bake the config into the image, so a boot calls nothing) and run again: new machines are up after 15 s.
